_about: Stable codes shared by the Designer Portal and the Field Repository (C26). This file is byte-identical in both repositories; tests/test_cross_portal_codes.py holds that. A code, once published here, is never reused or renumbered. Craft codes are the cxa-cms public site's craft slugs where the site has the craft. Add a spelling by appending it to a craft's list in BOTH repositories; add a craft by appending an entry.
